# ApplyMate

> ApplyMate is a job-application delegation platform for job seekers in India. Instead of manually filling out application forms, ApplyMate applies to relevant jobs on the user's behalf every day.

## What it does

- Matches a user's profile (skills, projects, college, experience) to relevant open job roles
- Submits tailored applications daily (10-15/day) through official company career portals only, with a cover letter written for each specific job
- Built for both freshers/students and working professionals
- Users can track every application (company, role, date, matched skills, status) from their dashboard

## Who it's for

- College students and recent graduates looking for their first job
- Working professionals looking to switch jobs without spending hours per day on applications

## Plans

- Free: user applies themselves, up to 30 applications/month, ₹0
- Basic: ApplyMate surfaces a daily job feed for the user to apply to, ₹399/30 days
- Pro (most popular): ApplyMate's team applies on the user's behalf, with application tracking, ₹1,999/30 days
- Max Pro: same as Pro, plus interview prep and a strategy call, ₹2,999/30 days

All paid plans run 30 days, one-time payment, no auto-renewal, cancel anytime.
